values.title: Garden overflow path map pending verification
values.body: The relationship between the foyer corner, linear drainage channel, planting area, and municipal storm drain has been listed as a contract verification item.

values.title: Updated evidence standards for garden drainage acceptance
values.body: Drainage acceptance must verify benchmark elevations and grading, drainage construction, post-rain or equivalent hose test observation, and images at the same time; a single surface observation showing no standing water cannot cover the pavement base course, overflow path, and drainage of the planting area.
